method: All available Unicode-mapped nonblank Han in 221 private BDFs compared at same Unicode against all three HP-UX sources. Exact stored rectangle and exact whitespace-trimmed bitmap; no scaling or padding. Unmapped glyph shape-set matches are a separate non-semantic diagnostic, not Unicode comparisons.

decMappedSupplement.method: Original DEC PCF codepoints from preserved recipes remapped according to original Tru64 Chinese documentation: first byte A1–FE; second A1–FE identifies CNS plane 1, second 21–7E identifies plane 2. Transcode those plane coordinates using glibc EUC-TW. No guessing from Unicode-looking code values or source slot indices.

sampleOnlySupplement.method: Sample-only exact 1-bit cropped-glyph template search in existing public PNGs for same Unicode Han named in each row text. Original HP-UX pixels, no scaling or border padding. Search covers complete target PNG; a match is a contained shape, not independently segmented glyph provenance. Nonmatches cannot establish full-font novelty. Alpha>128 and mean RGB<128 define public ink; reference-only photos excluded.

unchecked.reason: Reference image, not native font specimen
